anatomy.flutter: Switch builds a SelectionControl (the track: fill/border/shadow/radius) containing a private _Thumb — a TweenAnimationBuilder-driven Positioned Surface — which is exactly the two-slot shape: track + thumb, no more.
anatomy.web: SwitchPrimitive.Root (data-slot="switch", the track: rounded-pill border p-0.5) wrapping SwitchPrimitive.Thumb (data-slot="switch-thumb", rounded-full) — Radix's own two-part anatomy, matching the Dart track/_Thumb split.

api.flutter: Switch(value, onChanged, size: SwitchSize{sm,md}, enabled, disabledReason, invalid, focusNode, label, hint) — value/onChanged map to checked/onCheckedChange, size.label emits 'sm'/'default' the same as the web's data-size.
api.web: Switch({className, size = "default"|"sm", ...SwitchPrimitive.Root props}) forwarding checked/onCheckedChange/disabled/aria-invalid through Radix, with data-size driving data-[size=default]:h-6 w-11 / data-[size=sm]:h-5 w-9.
api.note: Not a defect — flagged only because the API surfaces differ in shape (Flutter's enabled+disabledReason+invalid+label+hint vs Radix's disabled/aria-invalid/aria-label passthrough) while resolving to the same two sizes and the same checked semantics; recorded platform-difference would also be defensible, but 'match' better reflects that both sides expose exactly {value/checked, onChange, size:sm|default, disabled, invalid}.

states.flutter: SelectionControl paints fill: value ? theme.primary : theme.muted, border: value ? primary : input, shadow: value ? Shadows.controlPrimary : Shadows.inset, and Switch.dart's own doc table records the disabled spelling as data-disabled (drift 14 — noted, not fixed).
states.web: data-[state=unchecked]:bg-muted data-[state=unchecked]:shadow-pressed vs data-[state=checked]:border-primary data-[state=checked]:bg-primary data-[state=checked]:shadow-btn-primary, focus-visible:ring-3 ring-ring/50, aria-invalid:border-destructive ring-destructive/20, data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-disabled:opacity-50.

disabled.flutter: Switch.enabled (ANDed with the enclosing FieldScope's) drives SelectionControl's Disabled wrapper, and disabledReason (falling back to the scope's) surfaces as a tooltip explaining why — the doc comment calls out that the switch spells this data-disabled unlike Checkbox/RadioGroupItem/Select's disabled: (forms-map drift 14, recorded not fixed).
disabled.web: data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-disabled:opacity-50 on SwitchPrimitive.Root, driven by Radix's disabled prop; no separate 'why disabled' explanation is rendered by this component itself, that lives in the Field wrapper elsewhere in the system.

interaction.flutter: toggle is wired through scope?.activator?.callback for a sibling <label>-style activation, and null while !isEnabled so a stale toggle cannot outlive its own legality — SelectionControl (not shown here) owns the actual FocusNode/Enter-Space wiring per its own contract.
interaction.web: Radix SwitchPrimitive.Root is a real <button role="switch">, so it gets native Space/Enter activation, Tab focus and label-for activation for free from the browser and Radix's own primitive.

semantics.flutter: Semantics(container: true, toggled: value, enabled: isEnabled && onChanged != null, label: name, hint: described) — a named, toggled, hinted node exactly mirroring role=switch/aria-checked/aria-label/aria-describedby.
semantics.web: Radix SwitchPrimitive.Root renders role="switch" aria-checked with aria-label/aria-describedby forwarded through ...props, and the after:-inset-x-3 after:-inset-y-2 pseudo-element expands the 44x24 (default) track's hit area well past the --size-target-min 44px floor.
